scene_script_excerpt:
SCENE 05 — Understanding the distinction — 6 seconds (provisional)
Setting and framing: Cut wider from Scene 04's camera side to a medium full-body three-quarter view at Sol's face height, angled slightly down. Sol stands left-center at x=32%, 42% of frame height, feet at y=75%; the same tended bough, added twig and small flame remain at right near x=74%, y=67%. Their arrangement and world-space scale stay coherent in the wider view. Give Sol's short arms clear silhouette space and keep the lower fifth quiet.
Lighting: Use the same cool diffuse clearing shade and localized amber light as Scene 04's ending. Illuminate Sol coherently with that ambient light and only a restrained warm tint on his fire-facing side.
Camera: shot_size: Medium full-body concluding reaction with the tended fire at right.; height_and_angle: Sol face height, slight downward angle; same side as Scene 04.; movement: Generation: stable camera after the wider cut.; editing: No additional camera move; retain a brief final reaction hold.; start_view: Sol x=32%, height 42%, feet y=75%; same tended wood at right.; end_view: Same source crop; required ending arm pose with gaze UP to the fixed Narrator point in a neutral phase of listening idle.
First frame: Sol stands grounded with both short arms gathered close to his outer flanks, face directed toward the tended fire in a shallow three-quarter orientation. Both original eyes are visible. The same bough, added twig and small separate flame are at right; no human hand is visible.

Sol: “So finding fire wasn't the same as making it.”
Narrator: “Right.”

Action: Begin in the exact approved first frame, both short arms beside the flanks and attention on the tended fire. Open both arms once into the supplied small low gesture of understanding during Sol's concluding sentence. Spring softly into this gesture with a coherent body bounce, overlapping flame-tip/lobe follow-through and one controlled rebound. Then, before Arthur's final Right, tilt the whole compact body gently back/up toward the fixed Narrator point above camera, flowing into the supplied approved ending pose. Face and filled layers move together; keep the normal eyes intact. Maintain above-camera attention and quiet connected listening idle throughout Right and the ending. Arms remain low after opening, both feet supported; no extra arm wave, inward windup or separate head turn.
